extra_vocab.en: the condition of not moving, falling, or changing easily
extra_vocab.note: 文中 stability testing 指測試推車在各種狀況下是否穩固、不容易翻倒。多益也常見於經濟、價格或情勢穩定的說明。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: stability 是不可數名詞，不加 s；當修飾語時用單數，如 stability test。

example.en: The stroller passed every stability test required for sale.
example.zh: 這款推車通過了銷售所需的每一項穩定性測試。

example.en: The central bank's main goal is price stability.
example.zh: 央行的主要目標是維持物價穩定。

example.en: Strong sales improved the company's financial stability this year.
example.zh: 強勁的銷售提升了公司今年的財務穩定性。

example.en: Engineers inspected the structural stability of the old bridge.
example.zh: 工程師檢查了這座舊橋的結構穩定性。

examples.en: Adding a wider base will improve the stability of the stand.
examples.zh: 加寬底座會提升這個支架的穩定性。

examples.en: Investors want political stability before they open new factories.
examples.zh: 投資人在開設新工廠前，希望看到政局穩定。

confusable.diff: sustainability 是「永續性」，指能長期維持而不損害環境

example.en: The report covers the firm's environmental sustainability goals.
example.zh: 這份報告涵蓋公司的環境永續目標。

confusable.diff: durability 是「耐用、耐久」，stability 是「穩定、不易晃動或變動」

example.en: Durability matters more than style for this work boot.
example.zh: 對這款工作靴來說，耐用度比款式更重要。

similar.diff: steadiness 較口語，指持續穩定不變

example.en: The steadiness of demand helped us plan production.
example.zh: 需求的穩定讓我們得以規劃生產。

similar.diff: balance 指平衡；stability 指整體穩固不易倒

example.en: A good balance of weight keeps the cart upright.
example.zh: 良好的重量平衡能讓推車保持直立。

example.en: Safety checks are part of every product launch.
example.zh: 安全檢查是每次產品上市的一部分。

example.en: We must test the strength of the frame before shipping.
example.zh: 出貨前我們必須測試車架的強度。

derived.link: stable 是詞幹；stable + -ity → stability，像 able → ability
stable 去 e 加 -y 變副詞

senses.en: the quality of staying firm and not falling over

example.en: The ladder's wide legs provide extra stability on uneven floors.
example.zh: 梯子寬大的腳架在不平的地板上提供額外的穩定性。

senses.en: the quality of not changing suddenly
senses.distinguish: 指價格、市場、政局等不易大幅波動

example.en: The economic report shows stability in housing prices.
example.zh: 經濟報告顯示房價趨於穩定。

extra_vocab.en: a possible result or effect of something
extra_vocab.note: 文中 review the safety implications 指審視設計改變可能帶來的安全影響。implication 通常用複數，後面常接 for。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: implication 常搭配 for：the implications for safety（對安全的影響），不用 to。

example.en: We must study the legal implications before signing the deal.
example.zh: 簽約前我們必須研究法律上的影響。

example.en: Please explain the financial implications of the new policy.
example.zh: 請說明新政策在財務上的影響。

example.en: A lawyer will review the legal implications of the contract.
example.zh: 律師會審閱合約的法律影響。

example.en: This decision may have implications for our summer schedule.
example.zh: 這項決定可能會對我們的夏季時程有影響。

examples.en: What are the implications of moving the launch date?
examples.zh: 把上市日期往後移會有什麼影響？

examples.en: The study suggests serious implications for small retailers.
examples.zh: 這項研究顯示對小型零售商有嚴重的影響。

confusable.diff: application 是「申請」，拼法與 implication 很像

example.en: Please submit your application form by Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 請在週五下午前提交您的申請表。

confusable.diff: implementation 是「實施、執行」，指把計畫付諸行動

example.en: The implementation of the plan begins next month.
example.zh: 這項計畫的實施將於下個月開始。

similar.diff: consequence 偏指事後實際發生的結果，常帶負面；implication 偏指可能的影響

example.en: Late delivery had serious consequences for the project.
example.zh: 延遲交貨對專案造成了嚴重後果。

similar.diff: impact 指影響的程度或力道；implication 指可能引發的結果

example.en: The new rule will have a big impact on sales.
example.zh: 新規定會對銷售造成很大的影響。

example.en: The new rule had a positive effect on morale.
example.zh: 新規定對士氣有正面影響。

example.en: We are pleased with the outcome of the negotiation.
example.zh: 我們對談判的結果感到滿意。

derived.link: imply 去 y 加 -ication 變 implication，像 apply → application
imply 的形容詞形，指沒有明說但被理解的

senses.distinguish: 通常用複數，後面接 for

example.en: Lower profit is one implication of the rising material costs.
example.zh: 利潤降低是原料成本上漲的影響之一。

senses.en: something suggested but not said directly
senses.distinguish: 常見 by implication（言外之意）

example.en: His comment carried an implication that prices would rise.
example.zh: 他的評論暗示價格將會上漲。

extra_vocab.en: the act of following rules, laws, or standards
extra_vocab.note: 文中 compliance teams 指負責確保產品符合法規與標準的團隊，說話者提到要與工程及法規遵循團隊確認測試要求。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: compliance 後面接 with：in compliance with the rules；動詞 comply 也要接 with（comply with the law）。

example.en: All suppliers must operate in compliance with local safety laws.
example.zh: 所有供應商都必須依照當地安全法規營運。

example.en: The audit will ensure compliance with company policies.
example.zh: 這次稽核將確保公司政策被遵守。

example.en: Regulatory compliance takes up most of the legal team's time.
example.zh: 法規遵循佔去法務團隊大部分的時間。

examples.en: Compliance with the new safety rules is mandatory for all staff.
examples.zh: 遵守新的安全規定是所有員工的義務。

examples.en: The compliance officer checks every report before it is published.
examples.zh: 法遵人員會在每份報告發布前檢查。

confusable.diff: complaint 是「客訴；抱怨」，拼法相近但意思完全不同

example.en: We received a complaint about the late delivery.
example.zh: 我們收到一件關於延遲交貨的客訴。

confusable.diff: compliment 是「讚美」，拼法與 compliance 開頭相近

example.en: The manager gave her a compliment on the clear report.
example.zh: 經理稱讚她的報告寫得清楚。

example.en: The new regulation covers all toys imported from abroad.
example.zh: 新法規涵蓋所有從國外進口的玩具。

example.en: Our products meet the latest international safety standard.
example.zh: 我們的產品符合最新的國際安全標準。

derived.link: comply 是詞幹；comply + -ance → compliance，像 appear → appearance

extra_vocab.note: 文中 use a mechanical stop to prevent it from rotating too far forward 指用機械擋塊防止握把向前轉過頭，句型為 prevent + 受詞 + from + V-ing。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: prevent + 受詞 + from + V-ing；不說 prevent + 受詞 + to V。

example.en: A strong lock prevents unauthorized staff from entering the room.
example.zh: 堅固的鎖可防止未經授權的員工進入房間。

example.en: Heavy rain prevented the trucks from reaching the warehouse.
example.zh: 大雨使卡車無法抵達倉庫。

example.en: We are preventing delays by checking orders early.
example.zh: 我們藉由提早檢查訂單來避免延誤。

example.en: Extra foam padding will prevent damage during long-distance shipping.
example.zh: 額外的泡棉墊可防止長途運送中的損壞。

example.en: Clear signs help prevent accidents in the loading area.
example.zh: 清楚的標示有助於防止裝貨區發生意外。

example.en: Regular software updates prevent the system from crashing unexpectedly.
example.zh: 定期的軟體更新可防止系統意外當機。

examples.en: This cover is designed to prevent dust from entering the motor.
examples.zh: 這個護蓋的設計是為了防止灰塵進入馬達。

examples.en: Please lock your computer to prevent data loss.
examples.zh: 請鎖定您的電腦以防止資料遺失。

confusable.diff: avoid 是自己主動避開，後接 V-ing；prevent 是阻止某件事發生
confusable.usage: avoid 後面直接接名詞或 V-ing（avoid delays）；prevent 要說 prevent A from V-ing。

example.en: We should avoid scheduling meetings on Friday afternoons.
example.zh: 我們應避免把會議排在週五下午。

confusable.diff: protect A from B 是保護 A 不受 B 傷害；prevent B 是阻止 B 發生

example.en: This case will protect your tablet from scratches.
example.zh: 這個保護殼能保護您的平板不被刮傷。

similar.diff: stop 較口語，後面接 stop A from V-ing 與 prevent 同義

example.en: Please stop the machine before you open the cover.
example.zh: 開啟護蓋前請先讓機器停止運轉。

similar.diff: keep A from V-ing 與 prevent A from V-ing 意思相同，較口語

example.en: A wide base keeps the shelf from tipping over.
example.zh: 寬大的底座讓架子不會翻倒。

example.en: A parked truck blocked the main entrance this morning.
example.zh: 一輛停放的卡車今天早上擋住了正門。

example.en: Better training helps reduce errors in the warehouse.
example.zh: 更好的訓練有助於減少倉庫裡的錯誤。

extra_vocab.en: something good that you get from something
extra_vocab.note: 文中 three main benefits 指替代設計的三項優點，說話者用 First、Second、Third 逐項條列，是簡報整理論點的常見做法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: benefit 當動詞時，「從…受益」用 benefit from；「使…受益」則直接接受詞（benefit all employees）。

example.en: We outlined the benefits of switching to a new supplier.
example.zh: 我們概述了更換新供應商的好處。

example.en: This training benefits every new member of the sales team.
example.zh: 這項訓練使業務團隊每位新成員受益。

example.en: Small shops benefited from the lower shipping rates.
example.zh: 小型商店因較低的運費而受益。

example.en: Many customers are benefiting from the extended warranty.
example.zh: 許多客戶正受益於延長保固。

example.en: The main benefit of this plan is lower maintenance cost.
example.zh: 這項計畫的主要優點是維護成本較低。

example.en: Our employee benefits include health insurance and paid vacation.
example.zh: 我們的員工福利包括健保與有薪假。

example.en: Small firms can benefit from government support programs.
example.zh: 小型公司可以從政府的扶助計畫中受益。

examples.en: The key benefit of this design is its simple structure.
examples.zh: 這個設計的主要優點是結構簡單。

examples.en: New employees receive full benefits after three months of service.
examples.zh: 新進員工在任職三個月後可享有完整福利。

confusable.diff: profit 是金錢上的「利潤」；benefit 是廣義的「好處」

example.en: The company reported a higher profit this quarter.
example.zh: 公司本季的獲利較高。

similar.diff: advantage 強調比別人有利的優勢；benefit 強調得到的好處

example.en: Low prices give us an advantage over our competitors.
example.zh: 低價讓我們比競爭對手更有優勢。

similar.diff: perk 口語，指職位附帶的小福利

example.en: Free parking is one of the perks of this job.
example.zh: 免費停車是這份工作的福利之一。

example.en: Staff received a bonus after the record sales year.
example.zh: 員工在創紀錄的銷售年度後領到獎金。

example.en: The company pays a monthly travel allowance to sales staff.
example.zh: 公司每月發給業務人員差旅津貼。

derived.link: benefit 的形容詞形（-ial：有…性質的），像 financial
bene-（好）+ -ficiary，得到好處的人，如保險受益人

example.en: One clear benefit of remote work is shorter commuting time.
example.zh: 遠距工作的一個明顯好處是通勤時間縮短。

example.en: The new policy will benefit all part-time staff.
example.zh: 新政策將使所有兼職員工受益。

senses.en: an advantage or good result from something
senses.distinguish: 泛指從某事得到的好處

example.en: Online ordering has many benefits for busy customers.
example.zh: 線上訂購對忙碌的客戶有許多好處。

senses.en: extra things a company gives to its workers
senses.distinguish: 常用複數 benefits，指健保、休假等

example.en: The job offers health benefits and a yearly bonus.
example.zh: 這份工作提供健康福利和年度獎金。

extra_vocab.en: depending on something, or needing it first
extra_vocab.note: 文中 subject to review by our patent team 表示這個方案要先經專利團隊審閱才算數，是商務文件中常用來保留條件的說法。
extra_vocab.pattern: N + subject to + N（approval / review / change）
extra_vocab.grammar_note: subject to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing（subject to approval），不接原形動詞。

examples.en: This offer is subject to approval by the finance department.
examples.zh: 這項報價須經財務部門核准。

examples.en: All schedules are subject to change without prior notice.
examples.zh: 所有時程表可能不經事先通知而變更。

examples.en: Delivery is subject to stock availability at the time of order.
examples.zh: 交貨須視下單時的庫存而定。

examples.en: Imported goods are subject to inspection at the border.
examples.zh: 進口貨物須在邊境接受檢查。

similar.diff: pending 當介系詞指「在…之前、等待…」，偏程序上暫時等待；subject to 強調以…為條件

example.en: The order is on hold pending final payment.
example.zh: 這筆訂單在最後付款完成前暫時保留。

similar.diff: depending on 表示「視…而定」，不一定有「須先取得」的意思

example.en: Prices vary depending on the quantity you order.
example.zh: 價格會依訂購數量而不同。

confusable.diff: due to 是「因為」，subject to 是「須視…而定、受…約束」

example.en: The flight was delayed due to heavy fog.
example.zh: 班機因濃霧而延誤。

confusable.diff: prone to 指「容易發生（多半是負面的事）」

example.en: Old devices are prone to overheating during long use.
example.zh: 舊裝置在長時間使用時容易過熱。
